newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani interbank call rates remain high.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani interbank call rates remain high.

text.p: Pakistan's interbank money market rates remained high on Wednesday because of scarce liquidity, dealers said.
"The interbank market gave no sign of easing off as borrowers could not get out of the woods and overnight funds were traded at the prevailing 20 percent mark," one dealer said.

Considerable amounts also changed hands at 22 and 23 percent, the dealer said. More than one billion rupees had been picked up by the central bank. This made the short-term scenario worse as the market was already closing short at the end of trading hours.
